_comment: Fragment for the orchestrator to merge into opencode.jsonc under "agent". Every model ID was verified against `opencode models anonrouter --verbose` (253 IDs, 2026-11-23). Provider prefix is required: anonrouter/<id>. Do not add model IDs to .opencode/agents/*.md.

orchestrator-architect.description: Coordinator: strongest verified reasoning model for gate decisions and delegation.

geometry-extractor.description: PDF/drawing extraction to calibrated geometry JSON. Strong long-context reasoning; image input not verified on anonrouter (see docs/model-routing.md).

blender-builder.description: Blender generator scripts (Python bpy). Closest verified coding-capable frontier route.

web-3d-builder.description: Next.js + Three.js viewer implementation. Complex web/3D work.

cinematic-director.description: Shot lists and HyperFrames composition planning. Video generation is NOT an LLM route; see docs/video-model-selection.md.

visual-qa-reviewer.description: Read-only visual and performance review of Playwright artifacts. Image input NOT verified; route to a multimodal model once verified.

doc-scribe.description: Repetitive documentation and boilerplate under docs/. Low cost tier.
